title: Print Window Row Column Border Alignment
description: Make SemioWindowRowTwo/Three stretch every window in a row to the tallest sibling height (bottom borders align). Add SemioWindowColumnTwo/Three symmetric primitive for right-border alignment. Add anchor key (nw, n, ne, w, center, e, sw, s, se) for content positioning within stretched boxes. Apply anchor=center to cover logo windows.
summary: Row windows now stretch to the tallest sibling so bottom borders align across SemioWindowRowTwo/Three. SemioWindowRowTwo/Three measure column heights, set \SemioWindowStretchHeightValue, and row Windows open tcolorbox with height= via expl3 semio_window_begin_row:n. anchor=center uses expl3 tl registers for valign/halign inside tcolorbox. Cover logo row uses anchor=center. Verified with verify-window-alignment.tex (Short/Tall) and verify-zwischenbericht-cover.tex (institution + logo rows).
